<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#063336" flood-opacity=".12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="43" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="20" y="27" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">9:41</text>
    <line x1="324" y1="24" x2="324" y2="19" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="329" y1="24" x2="329" y2="16" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="334" y1="24" x2="334" y2="13" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="347" cy="20" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="349" y1="22" x2="353" y2="26" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <rect x="360" y="14" width="23" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="363" y="17" width="16" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <rect x="384" y="18" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#121212"/>
  </g>

  <!-- abstract green background accents -->
  <g opacity=".95">
    <circle cx="15" cy="145" r="58" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
    <circle cx="365" cy="113" r="82" fill="#EAF8E3"/>
    <circle cx="344" cy="285" r="42" fill="#ADD993"/>
    <circle cx="34" cy="342" r="29" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
    <rect x="303" y="55" width="32" height="32" rx="16" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <rect x="47" y="86" width="13" height="13" rx="6.5" fill="#4B9460"/>
    <line x1="329" y1="173" x2="356" y2="193" stroke="#5DB075" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="28" y1="255" x2="52" y2="242" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- top brand -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="31" cy="68" r="17" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <line x1="25" y1="69" x2="37" y2="69" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="31" y1="63" x2="31" y2="75" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="56" y="75" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Mint</text>
    <text x="365" y="73" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#4B9460">1 of 3</text>
  </g>

  <!-- illustration card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="45" y="122" width="300" height="292" rx="28" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
    <circle cx="274" cy="181" r="23" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
    <circle cx="111" cy="335" r="17" fill="#ADD993"/>
    <line x1="88" y1="176" x2="114" y2="162" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="289" y1="329" x2="305" y2="315" stroke="#4B9460" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- food illustration -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx="194" cy="326" rx="91" ry="18" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
    <ellipse cx="194" cy="278" rx="78" ry="45" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4B9460" stroke-width="3"/>
    <ellipse cx="194" cy="270" rx="70" ry="35" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <circle cx="158" cy="260" r="14" fill="#E7574C"/>
    <circle cx="191" cy="248" r="13" fill="#FFAE1B"/>
    <circle cx="227" cy="266" r="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="211" cy="286" r="11" fill="#E4A70A"/>
    <circle cx="174" cy="291" r="12" fill="#2DCC70"/>
    <line x1="159" y1="214" x2="147" y2="190" stroke="#4B9460" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <ellipse cx="143" cy="184" rx="14" ry="8" transform="rotate(-32 143 184)" fill="#5DB075"/>
    <line x1="225" y1="216" x2="239" y2="191" stroke="#4B9460" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <ellipse cx="245" cy="184" rx="14" ry="8" transform="rotate(30 245 184)" fill="#5DB075"/>
    <rect x="169" y="300" width="51" height="7" rx="3.5" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".8"/>
  </g>

  <!-- pagination -->
  <g>
    <rect x="167" y="438" width="32" height="6" rx="3" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <rect x="207" y="438" width="8" height="6" rx="3" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <rect x="223" y="438" width="8" height="6" rx="3" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  </g>

  <!-- onboarding copy -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="493" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Homemade food,</text>
    <text x="195" y="529" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">made with heart</text>
    <text x="195" y="570" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Discover delicious meals prepared by</text>
    <text x="195" y="594" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">local home cooks and delivered to you.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- trust chip -->
  <g>
    <rect x="106" y="618" width="178" height="30" rx="15" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
    <circle cx="124" cy="633" r="8" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <polyline points="120,633 123,636 129,629" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="140" y="638" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#267347">Freshly made & local</text>
  </g>

  <!-- continue button -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="20" y="665" width="350" height="60" rx="18" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <text x="195" y="702" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Continue</text>
    <polyline points="277,694 285,700 277,706" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- skip -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="758" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4B9460">Skip for now</text>
    <line x1="142" y1="764" x2="248" y2="764" stroke="#4B9460" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="786" width="390" height="58" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="786" x2="390" y2="786" stroke="#EEEEEE" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- home -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="35,806 44,799 53,806 53,818 35,818" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <polyline points="32,807 44,797 56,807" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="44" y="836" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">Home</text>
    </g>
    <!-- search -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="132" cy="807" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="138" y1="813" x2="145" y2="820" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="134" y="836" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Explore</text>
    </g>
    <!-- orders -->
    <g>
      <rect x="212" y="799" width="16" height="18" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="216" y1="804" x2="224" y2="804" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.4"/>
      <line x1="216" y1="809" x2="224" y2="809" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.4"/>
      <text x="220" y="836" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Orders</text>
    </g>
    <!-- profile -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="319" cy="804" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <ellipse cx="319" cy="816" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#97A2B0" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="319" y="836" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
